source: Sanjin's coach config (board 09, Daily nudges by email) and Marcus's nudge unsubscribe boards, 18 Nov 2026
instructions: Write a short, warm email (max. 3 sentences) that picks up on the last chat: the plan, exercise or feeling the user named. End with one open question the user can answer by clicking “Continue with Mira”, which opens the chat with this message already in it. Keep the subject neutral, never mention body, sex or weight in it.

types.title: Follow up on the agreement
types.when: The day after a chat that ended with a small agreement
types.goal: Turn the agreement into action and hear how it went
types.example: Hi Lea, we agreed you’d leave one soft lamp on for the first minute. Did you get to try it? Either answer is completely fine.

types.title: Progress check
types.when: Once a week, on the user’s chosen day
types.goal: Make progress visible and keep the baseline up to date
types.example: Quick check-in: compared to when we started, how at home have you felt in your body this week? Tap a number from 1 to 5.

types.title: Have you heard of…?
types.when: A root cause is clear and no practice has been tried
types.teaser: Have you ever heard of this…
types.example: Have you ever heard of body neutrality? It’s about noticing what your body does for you, not how it looks. Want me to show you a two-minute version?

types.title: Root-cause question
types.when: A possible root cause came up but isn’t explored yet
types.teaser: Something from our last chat stayed with me…
types.example: Something from our last chat stayed with me: you said the feeling started around your first relationship. What do you remember about how your body was talked about back then?

types.title: A thought worth sharing?
types.when: No chat for 2 days or more
types.example: Did anything come up today that’s worth sharing? A small moment, a thought, a feeling. Even one sentence is enough.

types.title: Celebrate progress
types.when: After a streak or a better weekly rating
types.goal: Reinforce the change and build confidence
types.example: Three days in a row you tried your small step. That’s not nothing, that’s a pattern starting. What made it easier this time?
